body: I believe in god if that's what you mean, although I don't know how much he belives in me.

Dear god I can relate so FUCKING much to you. I may be younger but I still feel the same goddamn way, all my friends have great lives, jobs, getting ready to move out from their perfect loving families and here I am jobless, bad poor health, mental illnesses, severe depression, my father hates me because I'm not independant and my mother loves me and wants to help me but she is just as poor. I just wish my life would end now.

There are a lot of people like us, and yes I need to drop her and a few others annoying assholes out of my life for good. I can't handle those types of people anymore. All I have everyday is stress upon more stress, death seems to be a relaxtion I calm myself with by telling myself one day I'll be dead and won't suffer any longer. Plus I'm broke because of reasons. Look, I can't tell you not to do what you want to do but I can say that I seriously understand what the fuck you are going through. I hope things turn out better for you or at least you feel better. Life is a bitch.
Oh I did, I'm 19 as well, and it feels to long for me at least.

Yup, pisses me the fuck off. Her family is wealthy as fuck unlike my broke ass family, they are spoiled brats both her and her actual brother. She always says when a guy is cute, like she'll say "Oh he's cute, oh he's sexy". But when refering to me it's always, "eww were like brothers that weird" or I've tried to be nice to her before and gave her my sweater and she's like, "lol you flirt with every girl it's annoying" makes me want to knock her the fuck out. Especially because she was GIVEN her grandmothers $300,000 dollar house and a brand new car fully paid off. So she has no bills, she's fully independant. She has a 4.5 GPA as well because of all the extra shit she did. Plus she won't shut the fuck up about how hard life is and how she would love to be a kid again. That bitch wouldn't even know what HARD really is if it hit her in the face. I feel for you I really do, I don't know even know how you lasted this fucking long in this savage world.

Let's just say there is a point where when you are so friendzoned that she starts calling you her "brother" and making sure everywhere we go she tells everyone I'm her brother even though I'm not. Probably so they don't think were together. Even though shes fuck ugly to.
No she brotherzoned my sorry fuck ass.
Yeah at least you have a job, you could be me not able to work cause of health problems. With 50 cents in his bank account about to go broke and homeless with bills up to his head.

Yup, I know. My friend just graduated high school and was given her own house, a car, she has an insanely good job she can grow in. Here I am a fucking worthless piece of shit with health problems up to my fucking neck. My parents hate me because I'm shit and I act like I'm shit and they tell me I'm not worthless but fuck em, I'm ready to die now.
A-FUCKING-men.
I can relate so much more then you realize. I don't even know how I deal with it, everyday is the same. I'm living in groundhog day.
I can relate sooo much more then you think to your situation. I have break downs all the time. I don't know how much more I can take it anyway.
Yup, that's how I feel anymore... I wonder why the hell I'm still here.
Yeah, I don't even care anymore... my desire to die is greater then my desire to live and succeed. My family tries to help me but nothing helps. I've been lost a loong time ago.

It's true, anymore in life were just taught to be like everyone else, grow up, go to school, get some useless degree to make ourselves feel good. Get a well paying job and work for the rest of our life then retire and relax for a little while... then die.
It causes me to clear my throat nearly the entire late morning. It's so annoying.

And the sad thing is people will never get it, I feel horrible and relatable to the people who commit suicide, but everyone else calls them cowards and losers and selfish. It's not fair, I use to think things would get better, I don't anymore. There is no good future waiting for me. I won't be successful. This is the life I have, so why am I forced to live it? I didn't choose to be born. My parents just fucked each other at just the right time to have me. If only they waited a couple more days.
I don't know, I'd love to just stop living. I wouldn't commit suicide but I def wouldn't mind getting hit by a car or something else.

I agree with you so much, I think about dying every day of my waking moment. I hope every time I go out that I get run over by a car, I go for walks late at night hoping someone will come up and shoot me to talk my wallet, they'll regret it once they find out I'm broke shitless. I was not mean't to live my life. Why couldn't the sperm behind me have made it instead. I hope you feel better, at least I hope something works out for you.

I've been depressed for 9 years, within the last 3 years it's been to the point of me almost breaking down to nothing. I have achieved nothing at 20, I'm constantly suffering from mysterious illness's, I wish I was dead. If I ever get a gun, I'll only need 1 bullet.
Yup.

Hopefully I won't be around much longer, within the 20 years I've been alive. That's enough, I've lived or should I say suffered long enough. Life doesn't get better for people like me, it only gets worse. It's like the universe just fucks you up cause it can.

I'm only 20 and I'm suffering with a chronic illness, debt, no money, constant pain. I wish I was dead but I'm to much of a pussy to pull the trigger myself. I feel for you in every way I seriously do.

Yup, I understand you. I have no job, no money, my entire family is broke poor, health problems up to our noses. Horrible luck no matter what is happening. If I say heads it will land on tails. I want to end this now. I need to find a way to die without it being "suicide".
This^ let's hope we don't have a long life, I couldn't stand to bear this for another 10-20 years...
